clos.loDetails: Understand the movement of British literature as well as how literature of each period influenced each other;
Interpret the interesting beauty of literature in different literary aspects;
Recognize literary concepts and figures of speech, understand the lessons in each literary work and apply them in real life.
Be aware of the course importance and self-study habits to prepare for future career; enrich their human values by analyzing and selecting those from famous literary works.
